Postgres can be tested too, but database logic often sits outside those loops.
brief.whyItMatters: Most applications are limited by their database before anything else. Changes here reach schema design, query cost and how safely you can migrate.

items.title: Python Workers are now generally available
items.excerpt: Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. You can seamlessly integrate with Cloudflare's ecosystem including D1, R2, and Workers AI without writing any JavaScript glue code.

brief.whatHappened: The Cloudflare Blog published "Python Workers are now generally available". Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. You can seamlessly integrate with Cloudflare's ecosystem including D1, R2, and Workers AI without writing any JavaScript glue code.
brief.whyItMatters: The platform is the one dependency every web project shares. A feature reaching all browsers removes a library, and a regression explains a bug you did not write.
